memos.scout:
The honest case for buying DUVE is thin. The strongest points: the coin is alive, the class is labeled ORGANIC rather than factory, no airdrop dump was seen, and the last 15 minutes show heavy two-way volume (about $206k, 1,177 buyers, 964 sellers) with net flow only slightly positive at +25 SOL, so it isn't bleeding out. Top-3 holder concentration on the curve is low at 6.6%, and the 30-minute return is +161%.

But the demand case doesn't hold up. The 30-minute high was followed by a 45% drawdown, and the price is in a churn phase where sells nearly match buys (sell/buy ratio 1.04). Bundled buying was 42% of the curve, and a launch bot was present in the first two minutes, which argues against purely organic interest. Pool depth of 142 SOL is shallow enough that a $20 round trip would lose several percent to impact alone. Nothing in the brief shows buying pressure building toward a new high.

Verdict: no strong case. Skip.
memos.skeptic: Most likely loss: a dump after a 45% drawdown from the 30-minute high, with the buy side already exhausted. Over the last 15 minutes, sells (839 SOL) nearly matched buys (865 SOL), netting only 25 SOL, while sellers (964) outnumbered the 1,177 buyers in a way that signals distribution rather than accumulation. The curve shows a 42% bundle share and a 41% completer share, suggesting coordinated early buying that may now be cashing out. Pool depth is only 142 SOL, so a $20 exit would cost meaningful slippage, and a 1.4-5.1% round trip fee eats any small bounce. The 108% return over 15 minutes is the kind of pump that tends to reverse. Recommend skipping.
